2.  The petitioner has been an made accused in this case in connection with Special POCSO Case 64/23, Kurumgarh P.S. Case No. 11 of 2023 registered for offences punishable under Sections 366 (A), 376(AB) of I.P.C. and 6 of POCSO Act, which is pending in the Court of Exclusive Special Judge-Cum, Special Additional Judge--IV, Gumla.

entities.text: Court of Exclusive Special Judge-Cum, Special Additional Judge--IV, Gumla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. As per FIR, allegation is that the petitioner had eloped the minor daughter of the informant for solemnizing marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
The daughter of the informant and the present petitioner were in love with each other and they wanted to solemnize marriage with each other.
Petitioner is in judicial custody since 18.08.2023.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate in the trial of the case by remaining physically present as and when required and shall not indulge in any manner in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the witnesses of prosecution, hence, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
5. Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submitted that it is a case related to the sexual offence with a tender year girl.
Hence, the petitioner does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, it is a case of sexual offence with a tender age girl, the charges have been framed and the learned trial Court has requested six months' time to conclude the trial, I am not inclined to admit the petitioner on bail, which stands rejected.
7. The learned Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial of the case and conclude within six months otherwise petitioner shall be at liberty to renew his prayer for bail.
